title: fix(post): refuse Fanuc G76 when the start point is above material
body:
## What changed

- Added `start_in_air: bool` to `cl::ThreadCycle` and `ThreadCycleDto` (defaults to `false`).
- Added optional `AIR 1` flag to `THREAD` records in `crates/post/src/post/cnc_thread.rs` and exposed it to post scripts as `properties.StartInAir`.
- Refused G76 by name in `assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps` (`g76Why`) whenever `p.StartInAir !== true`.
- Added `cycle_infeed_band` and `part_band_clear` in `crates/motion/src/turning/thread_cycle.rs` to check the full rapid-infeed axial band `[min(start_s, s_deep) - insert_width/2, max(start_s, s_deep) + insert_width/2]` against the part silhouette and raw stock.
- Added `crates/app/src/operation/g76_start.rs` to refine `start_in_air` against the revolved part, stock and prior cuts. `TurnedAhead` now carries the grooving blade half-width `band`.
- Replaced isolated stock samples with continuous coverage checks after review. Each interval between stock profile breakpoints has a conservative bound above the root. Prior cuts must cover the full bound. Bounded subdivision checks coverage from several cuts. The check refuses G76 when it cannot prove clearance.
- Reduced blade and nose credit by the clearance margin. Blade credit follows the actual swept segment. The check also proves coverage between radial samples. It does not credit uncertain stock holes.
- Updated `crates/motion/src/turning/thread.rs` and `crates/motion/src/turning/revolve.rs` so a threading pass can start in free air in front of a free end face without false out-of-domain rest warnings.
- Updated the Fanuc G76 test bar fixtures and three golden `.nc` files to start in free air (`Z16.` / `Z16.625` / `Z0.6299`) instead of inside a solid `Z=40` bar.
- Moved the clearance algorithm to `crates/motion/src/turning/g76_clearance.rs`. The public API takes cut and pilot values.
- Kept stock breakpoints and document integration in `app`. Moved the radial-gap and diagonal-blade tests to the motion crate.
- Recorded the design choice in `docs/decisions/2878-fanuc-g76-start-in-air.md`.

## Cause

A Fanuc-type G76 cycle moves the insert from the start point to each pass depth at rapid traverse. Previously, `fanuc-lathe.cps` emitted G76 without checking whether the start point stood in free air, and `turning::thread` clamped pass starts to the part silhouette domain. As a result, G76 started inside solid material (for example at `Z77.4` inside a `Z=78` end face on the cone-thread part).

## Tests

### Pinning tests (red before fix, green after fix)

- `lathe_post_g76_start::g76_refuses_when_start_point_is_inside_a_solid_bar` (G76 refused by name, G32 still posts)
- `lathe_post_g76_start::g76_refuses_on_cone_thread_start_inside_end_face` (reproduces #2878 cone-thread part)
- `lathe_post_g76_start::g76_posts_when_start_point_is_in_free_air_in_front_of_end_face`
- `lathe_post_g76_start::g76_refuses_uncut_stock_in_front_of_end_face_and_posts_after_facing`
- `lathe_post_g76_start::g76_refuses_legacy_stream_without_air_flag`
- `camcraft-app::operation::g76_start::tests::relief_groove_wider_than_insert_passes_when_grooved_and_refuses_when_uncut_or_narrow`
- `camcraft-app::operation::g76_start::tests::flank_infeed_refuses_when_deep_pass_overlaps_end_face`
- `turning_thread_cycle::start_in_air_distinguishes_solid_bar_from_free_end_start`
- `operation::g76_start::tests::narrow_stock_rib_between_old_stations_refuses` pins the reviewer's narrow rib between axial samples.
- `turning_g76_clearance::radial_gap_between_prior_cut_capsules_refuses` pins a radial gap and permits cuts with a safe overlap.
- `turning_g76_clearance::diagonal_blade_does_not_credit_its_deep_tip_across_the_whole_band` pins the actual blade sweep.

- `turning_g76_clearance::pilot_values_prove_only_the_removed_cone` pins the motion API for pilot dimensions and cone coverage.

### Earlier mutation checks

- Removed `p.StartInAir !== true` guard in `assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps`: 4 of 5 tests in `lathe_post_g76_start` failed (red), then passed after restore (green).
- Disabled `g76_start::judge` in `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`: `g76_refuses_uncut_stock_in_front_of_end_face_and_posts_after_facing` failed (red), then passed after restore (green).
- Restored post-retain `lat.push(w0); lat.push(w1);` in `crates/motion/src/turning/revolve.rs`: `g76_posts_when_start_point_is_in_free_air_in_front_of_end_face` failed with `6.0000 mm rest` (red), then passed after restore (green).
- Forced `start_in_air = true` in `crates/motion/src/turning/thread_cycle.rs`: `start_in_air_distinguishes_solid_bar_from_free_end_start` failed (red), then passed after restore (green).

- Review fix mutation: restored the sampled production checks while keeping the new tests. All three new regression tests failed (RED). Restored the continuous checks: all five `operation::g76_start::tests` passed (GREEN).

### Earlier gate and clippy results

These results apply to the previous head, before the domain move.

- Previous head: `41ce5778c17a886edf7288bf4db544ce4e5b1d04`.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` fell back to batch because `crates/cl` changed. The full run completed 955 steps in 36.6 minutes. Only clippy failed. A minimal guard change fixed that lint. On that head, all five clearance pins passed. The failed-only clippy rerun passed: 1 step, 0 failed, 37 seconds.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed on that head: 2 minutes 58 seconds, 0 warnings.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` ran the reached motion and app lanes on that head. Result: 220 steps, 0 failed, 53.8 minutes. Motion passed 56 ordinary tests. App passed 42 ordinary tests.
- Three known #1950 failures remain. The gate classified these failures as expected and accepted them. They are failures, not passes:
  - `machining2d::pocket_hsm::ring_tests::the_stock_ring_level_reaches_the_air_planner_with_the_stock`
  - `machining2d::pocket_hsm::ring_tests::the_stock_ring_level_plans_adaptive_with_no_budget_note`
  - `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_whole_model_bore_roughs_adaptive_on_each_level`

### Latest review fix and checks

Head: `3c3f8b1d8b72b225459a63d71948f15c2c100267`.

- Moved `AheadCut`, coverage checks, and focused tests to `camcraft-motion`. App collects the cut and pilot values.
- Placement mutation: restored the original app-only module and kept the motion API test. The test build failed with `E0432` (RED).
- Restored the domain move. All three `turning_g76_clearance` tests passed (GREEN).
- All three retained `operation::g76_start::tests` passed. These include the narrow-stock-rib regression.
- `rustfmt --check` passed for the changed concrete files.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: GREEN: 956 steps, 0 failed, 22.5 minutes. The gate used the batch fallback because `crates/cl` changed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN: all four touched crates passed with 0 warnings in 36.82 seconds.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: GREEN: 220 steps, 0 unexpected failures, 36.9 minutes. Motion passed 56 ordinary tests. App passed 42 ordinary tests. The gate accepted the three known #1950 expected failures listed above. These are failures, not passes. Reached lanes: motion and app.

## Goldens moved

- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/fanuc-lathe/thread_g76.nc`: `G00 X12.1 Z14.` -> `G00 X12.1 Z16.` (start point moved into free air past the free end face).
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/fanuc-lathe/thread_g76_area.nc`: `G00 X12.1 Z14.625` -> `G00 X12.1 Z16.625` (flank-infeed start point moved into free air past the free end face).
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/inch/fanuc-lathe/thread_g76.nc`: `G00 X0.4764 Z0.5512` -> `G00 X0.4764 Z0.6299` (inch start point moved into free air past the free end face).

## Not exercised

- Execution on a physical Fanuc lathe control or third-party Fanuc simulator.
- `assets/posts/tormach-lathe.cps` G76 refusal (out of scope for #2878; can reuse `properties.StartInAir` in a follow-up).

## Overlaps

- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`: touches the same file, different function/arm as open PRs #2853, #2836, #2833, #2831, #2822, #2716, #2714, #2678; whichever merges second refreshes.
- `crates/app/src/operation/mod.rs`: touches the same file, different module declaration as open PRs #2853, #2836, #2833, #2716, #2714, #2678; whichever merges second refreshes.

Changelog: Refuse Fanuc lathe G76 cycles whose start point stands above material and allow free-air starts in front of the end face or in a relief groove wider than the insert.
Effort: high
Fixes #2878
